description: Search files by metadata (`filters`) and/or filename substring (`name`). At least one is required. Same as `uploads find`.

all.description: Follow the cursor and return every page, up to a bounded number of requests. A non-null `cursor` in the result means that bound was reached before the end — pass it back to continue.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from a previous call's `cursor`. Pass it back unchanged with the same filters/name to get the next page; a null `cursor` means there are no more pages.

filters.description: Equality filters; all must match. Use `path` for the route (e.g. /settings), not route/page/screen. Optional when `name` is set.

name.description: Case-insensitive substring match on object keys (1–128 chars). Optional when `filters` is non-empty.

prefix.description: Key prefix filter, combinable with filters/name.

workspace.description: Override the workspace for this call (like the CLI's --workspace flag).

name: find_files
title: Find files
